name: RS-FIM benchmark
description: RS-FIM benchmark evaluates flood inundation map prediction using remote-sensing-derived benchmark maps. It focuses on how benchmark quality, bias, and enhancement procedures affect the assessment of model-predicted flood inundation maps.
evaluation_method: Map agreement metrics between predicted and reference inundation masks, such as accuracy, precision/recall, IoU/F1-like overlap scores, with analysis under high-confidence, degraded, and gap-filled benchmarks.
notes: This benchmark is especially about benchmarking robustness and bias in the reference maps themselves, not only model performance. No fixed question count was provided in the source metadata.
